key_highlights: ASX logged a positive week following an $80b US midterms relief rally, though daily trading saw late-week profit taking.
Iconic department store David Jones collapsed into voluntary administration after failed landlord negotiations, creating retail sector contagion.
Qantas flagged a $1B fuel expense surge, driving plans to hike airfares and trim flight capacity.
NextDC rallied on secular AI and cloud infrastructure demand, while NAB slumped on margin headwinds.

sectors.trend: Severe distress in discretionary retail culminating in David Jones entering administration.
sectors.implications: Elevated tenant vacancy risk and rent renegotiation pressures for landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX); severe cash flow strain on unpaid suppliers.

sectors.trend: Strong institutional support for digital infrastructure assets fueled by AI data center growth.
sectors.implications: Premium multiples sustained for NextDC (NXT.AX) as defensive growth and expansion prospects attract capital.

sectors.trend: Major banks face headwinds from margin compression and persistent RBA policy tightening scrutiny.
sectors.implications: NAB's sharp pullback highlights sector sensitivity to slowing credit demand and mortgage affordability constraints.

sectors.trend: Airlines hit by rising jet fuel expenses while crude oil declines offer broader industrial relief.
sectors.implications: Qantas (QAN.AX) faces margin compression and demand elasticity risks as it lifts ticket prices to offset $1B fuel headwinds.

sectors.trend: Active equity capital markets in gold alongside focused junior exploration across precious and critical minerals.
sectors.implications: Strong appetite for gold capital raisings supports project development among junior and mid-tier miners.

key_themes: Retail insolvencies and commercial real estate tenant exposure
Persistent RBA hawkish rhetoric against excess demand and inflation
Aviation sector cost headwinds from jet fuel spikes

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail REITs and non-essential consumer stocks; focus on consumer staples and essential retail.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA Hawkish Stance and Housing Credit Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to highly leveraged domestic banks and housing-sensitive equities; favour quality balance sheets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Airline Margin Squeeze from Fuel Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor capacity cuts and fuel surcharges; manage exposure to transport operators facing consumer demand elasticity.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight digital infrastructure and cloud providers.
opportunities.rationale: Secular AI workload demand and contracted data center capacity offer structural growth insulated from domestic retail headwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical allocation to gold miners amid robust capital raisings.
opportunities.rationale: Gold provides defensive hedging against geopolitical risk, currency volatility, and domestic macroeconomic softening.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to retail REITs with department store tenancy.
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones administration increases vacancy duration and potential re-leasing concessions across major shopping centers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Adopt cautious positioning on domestic carriers.
defensive_moves.rationale: A $1B surge in fuel costs combined with planned fare hikes threatens discretionary travel volumes as consumer budgets tighten.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound trading for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) as post-US midterm rally momentum faces drag from retail weakness and bank margin pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive over 6–12 months, pending clarity on RBA terminal rate trajectory and stabilization in household balance sheets.
key_catalysts: David Jones creditor outcome and store footprint rationalization
Upcoming RBA interest rate decision and statement on monetary policy
Qantas capacity adjustments and domestic passenger demand data
US midterm policy implementation and commodity demand trends
watch_list: RBA cash rate expectations and core inflation prints
Australian housing clearance rates and dwelling price indices
Singapore jet fuel crack spread and Brent crude oil benchmarks
